prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1172; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is pursuing a claim for compensation.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please inform us so we can address it.

We request that you provide a complete statement of the liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the collision.

We also ask that your company and your insured preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, recorded statements, claim file materials, repair estimates, and any communications concerning the collision. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt response.
